plan.title: Recreate Order offered on awarded RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded RFQ with a PO, as required for this case.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the test tenant.
Verify Recreate Order is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Recreate Order to open its window without confirming any change.
Confirm that the Recreate Order window opened.
Cancel the Recreate Order window so the event remains unchanged.
Verify the Recreate Order window closed after cancellation.
